prompt: What is the defining requirement for a physical equation to be homogeneous with respect to SI base units?

options.label: A
options.text: Both sides of the equation must evaluate to the same numerical magnitude.

options.label: B
options.text: Every term separated by addition or subtraction, and both sides of the equation, must have the same SI base units.

options.label: C
options.text: The equation must contain only base quantities and no derived quantities.

options.label: D
options.text: The equation must be proven to describe a real physical system under all conditions.
